whyItMatters: php debug mode is enabled (display_errorss*[=:]s*(?:On|1|stdout)), exposing internals to whoever reaches the service.
actions: Gate the switch with an environment check, defaulting off.
Fail startup when debug is on outside development.
Re-run the scan and confirm no debug switch remains enabled.
verification: Rescan shows no enabled debug switch, and production starts with debug off.
